title: LOAD PROGRAM SET(ptr) LENGTH(len): NORMAL for a defined program (pointer set, LENGTH above zero, RELEASE), PGMIDERR RESP2 1 for an undefined one; the loaded bytes are not compared

scenarios.summary: CALDST LOADs the defined program CALDTG with SET and LENGTH (pointer preset null, LENGTH preset 0), logs whether each was set, then RELEASEs it; the loaded bytes are never read
CALDSX LOADs a program with no definition (PGMIDERR RESP2 1; pointer and LENGTH not read), then LOADs CALDTG (NORMAL) and RELEASEs it
